current.title: Asli Maalkin
current.logline: Tara, ek masoom 'orphan' dulhan, apne pati ki family se apni gareebi ke taane sunti hai. Par unhe nahi pata, woh is sheher ki sabse badi construction company ki gupt CEO hai, jiske project par unki family ka future tika hai.
current.characters: Tara: Secret CEO of Skyline Group, disguised as a simple homemaker. Wants true love and respect. Aarav: Struggling architect, Tara's husband. Unaware of her true identity. Wants to succeed and make his family proud. Mrs. Sharma: Aarav's mother. Greedy and classist. Wants a rich daughter-in-law. Priya: Aarav's sister. Spoiled and materialistic. Looks down on Tara. Mr. Gupta: High-ranking official at Skyline Group, loyal to Tara.
arc: Part 1: Ghar ke kaam karti Tara, ek aam dulhan ki tarah dikhti hai. Mrs. Sharma aur Priya use uski gareebi aur kam 'status' ke taane maarte hain. Aarav ko bura lagta hai, par woh chup rehta hai. Audience ko pata chalta hai jab Tara apne 'simple' kamre mein ek luxury phone par multi-crore deal ki baat karti hai — woh Skyline Group ki CEO hai! Mrs. Sharma khushi se announce karti hai ki Aarav ko uski dream project ke liye Skyline Group se meeting mili hai. Tara yeh sunkar haath se plate gira deti hai, uski aankhein badi ho jaati hain. 'Dekh, nautanki!' Mrs. Sharma use daanti hai.

Part 2: Aarav apna design lekar Skyline Group ke chote project ke liye jaata hai. Tara uske design mein ek chota sa 'improvement' batati hai, jise Aarav dismiss kar deta hai. Shaam ko ek family dinner mein, jahan ek 'big shot' guest (jo Aarav ko Skyline tak pahuncha sakta hai) aana hai, Mrs. Sharma Tara ko uske 'simple' kapdo ke liye taane maarti hain. Dinner par, Tara ko naukrani ki tarah serve karne ko kaha jaata hai. Guest, Mr. Gupta, Tara ko nazarandaaz karta hai aur badtameezi se pesh aata hai. Lekin jab woh Aarav ke design ki tareef karta hai, toh woh Tara ke hi bataye hue improvement ka zikr karta hai. Aarav hairan ho jaata hai. Mr. Gupta ab Tara ko ek ajeeb nazron se dekh raha hai. 'Tumne kaha tha...?'

Part 3: Mr. Gupta, jisne Tara ko dinner par naukrani samjha tha, ab use phone par 'Madam CEO' kehkar baat karta hai, uski asli identity confirm karta hai aur uske saath behtar treatment ka vaada karta hai. Lekin ghar par, Mrs. Sharma Aarav ko ek badi builder ki beti, Priya Agarwal se milwaati hai, Aarav ke liye 'perfect match' batati hai. Tara ko is meeting mein chai serve karne ko kaha jaata hai. Priya Agarwal apni daulat ka ghamand dikhaati hai aur Tara ko baar-baar neecha dikhaati hai. Galti se Tara Priya ki mehengi saree par chai gira deti hai. Priya zordaar tamasha karti hai. Mrs. Sharma gusse mein Tara ko thappad maarti hain. 'Iss naukrani ko abhi ke abhi ghar se bahar nikalo! Aur tu, Aarav, isse divorce de!'

Part 4: Thappad ke baad Tara wahin khadi reh jaati hai, chehre par koi emotion nahi. Priya Agarwal muskurati hai. Aarav apni maa ko rok nahi paata. Agle din, Aarav apne bade project ki meeting ke liye Skyline Group ke boardroom mein hai, bahut nervous. Main CEO abhi tak nahi aaya hai. Ek board member Aarav se ek mushkil sawaal poochta hai, jiska jawab Aarav ko nahi aata. Aarav ghabra jaata hai. Tabhi, darwaza khulta hai. 'Sorry, I'm late,' ek jaani-pehchani awaaz aati hai. Tara andar aati hai, ek powerful business suit mein, aur seedhe Aarav ki taraf dekhti hai. 'Toh, Mr. Sharma, where were we?'

Part 5: Aarav ke haath se pen chhoot jaata hai. Poora boardroom khada ho jaata hai, 'Good morning, Ma'am' kehta hai. Tara calm hokar apni chair par baith jaati hai. Woh Aarav se wahi mushkil sawaal poochti hai jise woh abhi tak answer nahi kar paaya tha. Aarav fafanaata hai, uska chehra sharam se laal ho jaata hai. Tara Aarav ke design par wahi points uthaati hai jo Mrs. Sharma ne use neecha dikhane ke liye use kiye the. Phir woh Aarav ko dismiss kar deti hai, kehti hai ki uska project abhi ready nahi hai. Mrs. Sharma aur Priya Aarav ko 'surprise' karne ke liye office aa jaati hain, CEO ke cabin mein ghusne ki koshish karti hain. Receptionist unhe rokne ki koshish karti hai. Tabhi, Tara ka darwaza khulta hai, aur woh bahar kadam rakhti hai. Mrs. Sharma chillati hain, 'Yeh ghar ki naukrani yahan kya kar rahi hai?!'

Part 6: Mrs. Sharma ke shabdon ki goonj poore office mein phail jaati hai. Tara ek dum shant, unhe dekhti hai. Poora office staff aur Aarav stunned hain. Tara Mrs. Sharma ki taraf dekhti hai, phir Aarav ki taraf. 'Naukrani?' woh dheere se poochti hai. 'Agar main naukrani hoon... toh yeh poori Skyline Group company kiski hai?' Woh apne haath se poore luxurious office ki taraf ishara karti hai. 'Aur yeh deal... jiske liye Mr. Sharma apni jaan laga rahe hain... woh kaun approve karega?' Woh phir Aarav ki taraf dekhti hai, uski aankhein sard hain. 'Mr. Sharma, aapki family ko lagta hai ki aapko mujhse zyada 'rich' dulhan milni chahiye. Toh... main divorce papers kal subah bhej dungi.' Mrs. Sharma aur Priya zameen par girne wale hote hain, unki bolti band hai. Tara apna phone uthaati hai. 'Mr. Gupta? Woh Agarwal Group ke saath deal cancel kar dijiye. Aur Mr. Sharma ki family ke saare outstanding payments bhi hold par rakh dijiye. Abhi.' Mrs. Sharma wahin behosh ho jaati hain. Tara phone rakhti hai, Aarav ko dekhti hai, uski aankh se ek aansu girta hai. 'Khel khatam, Mr. Sharma.'
current.soFar: Tara, jo sabke saamne ek gareeb, anath dulhan ki tarah dikhti hai, asal mein Skyline Group ki gupt CEO hai. Ghar par uski saas Mrs. Sharma aur nanad Priya uski gareebi ka mazaak udaati hain, aur pati Aarav aksar chup rehta hai. Aarav apni dream project ke liye Skyline se deal karna chahta hai. Ek family dinner mein, Skyline ke official Mr. Gupta guest ban kar aate hain aur Tara ko naukrani samajhkar usse badtameezi se pesh aate hain. Lekin woh Aarav ke design mein Tara ke bataye hue improvement ki tareef karte hain, aur unhe Tara ki asli pehchan ka ehsaas hota hai. Raat mein, Mr. Gupta phone par Tara se maaf maangte hain aur uski 'Madam CEO' identity confirm karte hain. Ghar par, Mrs. Sharma Aarav ke liye Priya Agarwal, ek bade builder ki beti, ka rishta lekar aati hain aur Tara ko chai serve karne ka hukm deti hain. Priya Agarwal Tara ko baar-baar neecha dikhaati hai. Gusse mein Tara se galti se Priya Agarwal ki mehengi saree par chai gir jaati hai. Mrs. Sharma Tara ko zordaar thappad maarti hain aur Aarav ko use divorce dene ka hukm deti hain. Agle din, Aarav apne dream project ki meeting ke liye Skyline Group ke boardroom mein hai, jahan use ek mushkil sawaal ka jawaab nahi aata. Tabhi, Tara ek powerful CEO ke roop mein boardroom mein pravesh karti hai, aur seedhe Aarav ki taraf dekhti hai.
current.cliffhanger: Tara ne Aarav ki taraf dekha. Uski aankhon mein ab koi shanti nahi thi, balki ek thandi si chamak thi. Uski awaaz mein wahi authority thi jo usne darwaze se andar aate waqt suni thi. 'Toh, Mr. Sharma,' usne kaha, uski awaaz mein ek naram sa taana tha, 'where were we?'
